matchupItemFlags: no armor vs a 4-physical enemy comp

notes: Their main damage was Wraith (62k physical); 2/5 of us itemized armor.
Enemy ran 2/5 on or near their meta core.

coaching.headline: Down 1-5 and 0-4 in the mid-game fights, the team won it on the late map — the 34-minute 5-0 at our Primal Fangtooth was two of us against all five of them.
coaching.team: The first half was ragged — 1-5 at our river at 13.4, 0-4 at their Fangtooth at 16.8, and eight of us caught out alone across the game while a 16/7 Wraith sniped anything that walked solo. What won it was objective priority once the fights stabilized: 93378 objective damage to their 30859, Orb Prime at 28 and 36, Genesis Core at 31, Primal Fangtooth at 35, with the 22-minute 4-2 at our Fangtooth as the turn. The film flags Yin with no armor against a four-fifths-physical comp; more armor would have made the middle 15 minutes much cheaper.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 34-minute fight at our Primal Fangtooth — Sparrow and Gideon standing two against five and winning 5-0 — cashed straight into Primal at 35 and Orb Prime at 36, and the game ended two fights later.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Sparrow turned the late game into 16/4 with 46580 hero damage and 38058 objective damage, capped by the two-man 5-0 at 34 that decided the game. Surviving a lane read 'theirs early' to become the late-game answer is the carry job done in full.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Steel absorbed 86519 mitigated and handed out 21 assists winning the support matchup wire to wire. Seven deaths is the tax of frontlining that long; the one flag is 36.6, ahead in lane while the team won a fight outnumbered without him.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Yin led the match in objective damage at 42864 and added 7 kills, but eleven deaths — including back-to-back solo catches by Wraith at 23.7 and 25 and the 27.8 fall that priced their Primal Fangtooth — is the drill. With no armor into a comp led by Wraith's 62k physical, walking his sightlines alone was donating resets.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.3s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
ourKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
ourKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
enemyKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
enemyKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,600 hero damage a minute, more than 92% of Wraith mid players this patch (33% of the team's). The damage came from Absolution, Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds.
Back It Up! at rank 3: 95s base, about 88s by the end (7% shorter) from 8 ability haste: Typhoon 8.
Wraith dealt 62,392 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +265 physical power from items.
Absolution (item): On being Immobilized: Gain 25% Damage Mitigation. Gain 40% Movement Speed. Lasts 3s.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Alpha's Court (Eternal minor): Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.

Sustain: 15% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; 2,673 healing recorded.
Toughness: +100 health, +40 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 34,862 damage, mitigated 25,347, died 7 times.

loadout.plain: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.

loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Basic attacks mark her target: she deals more damage to them and takes less from them. Fits her steady single-target attacking while Relentless stacks build.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Adds a bit of damage to each basic attack that grows while she keeps hitting a hero, and heals her. Strong with Heightened Senses' attack speed.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps rising each second Sparrow stays in a hero fight, so long fights favor Sparrow more as they go. Weak in quick skirmishes.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: Dash and empower her next hit, which hits much harder on low-health targets and can be recast after a kill. Use it to finish someone softened by Piercing Shot.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 3 of the 5 players Sparrow killed built physical armor (Boris, Eden, Crunch).

copy.text: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 49.1% in 1,136 Sparrow carry games, level with the hero's 49.9%; this 3-item core: 56.3% in 782 games, level with the 55.6% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
